# LaySun

> LaySun manufactures premium fire-rated artificial plants, artificial trees, green walls, and commercial plantscaping systems for hotels, restaurants, offices, retail spaces, and other commercial environments worldwide.

LaySun is a factory-direct commercial supplier based in Dongguan, China. Core capabilities include custom sizing and species matching, natural wood trunks, hand-shaped PE foliage, fire-rated materials, project specification support, and worldwide shipping. Content on this site is intended for commercial buyers, architects, interior designers, hospitality operators, procurement teams, and plantscaping professionals.
